note: Stage 1 only. No roster world was trained on and no fit was run. World 104 is used for profiling and fixtures only; every learner here was discarded. Nothing is concluded about any learner or rule.

1_default_parity.allowed_renaming: check 2 names the files it read: sz_oracle/sz_solver in place of target_oracle/target_solver

admission_scoring_fixtures.condition: the oracle responder scores every first-encounter probe, both members of every twin and every taught-panel item; the ten-byte-suffix responder scores no twin; both through sz_score's own schedule, references and readings

first_probe_only_criterion_as_first_writ.condition: correct invariant AND broken logits move AND broken response bytes differ across the ten reveals (both arms' logits)

F2_boundary_rule_can_fail.note: 'broken' cuts the chunk one target later than the rule, so that its last input is '=' and its last target the first answer digit; the condition holds when the correct boundary's response does not move with the reveal and the broken one's does

F4_probe_on_off_parity.compared: every weight, every AdamW state tensor (step, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq), the carried state, cursor, updates, targets, inputs read, cuts used, schedule index, the loss log

registered_D60.criterion: last quarter: at least 100 crossing instances, at least 50% right

forecast_84_fits.basis: sizes from world 104's own streams at every setting (other worlds differ only in filler bytes, so in bytes by well under 1%); CPU per update, per probe and per panel from the four 256-presentation paths profiled on world 104 (500 updates each, run beside at most two other processes); checks and generation from world 104 at every setting

cpu_seconds_development_runs.note: Development and test runs of stage 1 outside the recorded processes, user+sys CPU from `time` where it was used; the rest estimated and marked so. All on world 104 or on no world.

dry_runs_of_the_fit_driver.note: world 104, 97/4, arm B wider and arm A ordinary: run only to show the driver works end to end and refuses to overwrite; not fits, not readings, not to be read as results
